title_q: Thank You, Clayton and the Sachs Family
headline: A personal thank-you to Clayton and the Sachs family from the clinic floor: two boys going into surgery today, two girls back a year later and doing what they love.
story: Mackinnon greets Clayton and the Sachs family from Clínica Noel.
Two boys go into surgery today. Two girls came back a year after theirs, and now they can just be kids and dream big.
Thank you from the bottom of her heart. Come along someday.
do: Use the single take, start to finish.
Keep captions on for the whole message.
Caption Clínica Noel with the accent.
dont: No name super, no title, no logo at the start.
No B-roll. It is a personal message.

bp_intro: All source times are in Mincho5119.MP4 (one camera, Mackinnon only). Times come from the transcript and are accurate to about 1 s. Line 00:32 is her, though the transcript labels it “Interviewer”.

rows.visual: Start on frame 1: she is already talking to the lens.
rows.motion: Captions from the first word. “Clínica Noel” with the accent (transcript: Clinic Unwell). “Sachs” (transcript: SACS). No name super: they know her.

voice.quote: Hola Clayton. Hi Sachs family. I'm here at Clínica Noel in Colombia.

rows.visual: Same take. No cuts: it should feel like a phone call.

voice.quote: We're having the most amazing day meeting patients, hearing their stories. We've met two young boys who are going in for surgery today and two chicas, two girls who came back from having surgery last year so we could see how they're doing

and the transformation is amazing. They're going from, you know, kids who had a lot of pain and weren't able to do things that they love to do to now being able to do whatever their heart wants and just really be a kid and dream big about what's ahead.

rows.motion: Captions only. “Watsi” with a capital W (transcript: WOTC).

voice.quote: So I want to thank you from the bottom of my heart. It's been so cool to get to know you over the last year and I can't thank you enough for showing up for Watsi and making all of this possible.
It'll be fun to come with me someday, so let's talk about that next time I see you. Thanks. Ciao.

rows.visual: Light end card. Light cyan #D3EDFA background.
rows.motion: watsi.org, all lowercase, Lato, navy #2E2844. Nothing else.

tech: One camera, 2-ch audio recorded into the camera. Mincho5118 from the same run is vertical with a rotation flag; check 5119 on import.

If it plays vertical: none, scale to 1080×1920. If it plays 16:9: crop 9:16 centered on her.
2 channels in the camera file. Pick the live channel on the waveform and map it to both sides. (Not measured: the Drive download limit stopped the audio check.)
Lato Bold, white, soft shadow, large. Pop word by word. No highlight box, no shading block. One line at a time. Always on screen, also in pauses. Keep the bottom 20% clear for app buttons.
H.264 MP4, 1080×1920, about 16 Mbps. One file.
checklist: Read every caption against the audio.
Clayton and Sachs are spelled exactly like this.
Clínica Noel has the accent on the í.
Watsi has a capital W only. watsi.org is lowercase.
No music and no extra branding.
